claim_en: Full 3D intravascular microgravity target
claim_zh: 完整三维血管内微重力目标
assumptions: Deformable vessel, physiological boundaries, FSI and actuator calibration
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Calibrate parameters and close fluid/wall/robot interface power

claim_en: Variable-mass Legendre transform retains geometric inertia
claim_zh: 变质量Legendre变换保留几何惯性
assumptions: Smooth fixed-base embedding and SPD M(q); use full derivative for moving base
open_or_excluded_conclusion: ROM truncation and full spatial discretization bounds remain open

claim_en: Magnetic force and torque follow one potential
claim_zh: 同一磁势给出磁力和力矩
assumptions: Fixed hard magnetic material moments and external-field approximation
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Include hysteresis/demagnetizing free energy if needed; calibrate coils

claim_en: 16/32/64-segment spatial rod computations exist
claim_zh: 16/32/64段空间杆计算已运行
assumptions: Prescribed flow, rigid lumen and engineering contact penalty; fixed declared protocols
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Not a continuum, clinical, patient-specific or fully coupled FSI certificate

claim_en: Transported Pfaff form represents a compatible local Birkhoff field
claim_zh: 输运Pfaff形式给出局部相容Birkhoff表示
assumptions: Smooth local flow; closed initially nondegenerate form; invertible flow map
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Uniform domains, transport errors and construction costs on actual 12-DoF ROM

claim_en: Endpoint graph theorem requires form matching and transversality
claim_zh: 端点生成图要求二形式匹配和横截性
assumptions: Feng-Qin Ch15 Thm3.5/4.1; det(C+D) initially and det(CF+D) during evolution; reconstruction branch
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Verify the actual endpoint map; f0 is alpha1 on the diagonal, not always zero

claim_en: Time-dependent generating evolution and truncation are conditional
claim_zh: 时变生成演化及截断结论有条件
assumptions: Feng-Qin Ch15 Thm4.4/4.5; analytic gradient coefficients, fixed generating coordinate, det(A_alpha-N_h C_alpha) != 0 for truncated endpoint reconstruction, valid branch
open_or_excluded_conclusion: General recursive chart integration has not been connected to the geometric ROM

claim_en: Original 36 is corrected matrix midpoint, usually second order
claim_zh: 原36修正为矩阵中点、通常二阶
assumptions: Constant matrices for elimination; smooth stable branch for order; variable mass remains implicit
open_or_excluded_conclusion: No blanket symplecticity under damping, contact or arbitrary feedback

claim_en: Central cubic generator gives a fourth-order canonical method
claim_zh: 三次中央生成项给出四阶正则格式
assumptions: Autonomous Hamiltonian, sufficient high derivatives, symmetric Hessian, nonsingular implicit branch
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Do not transplant autonomous formula to arbitrary dissipative/time-varying chart fields

claim_en: Finite-time error separates step, solve and representation residuals
claim_zh: 有限时间误差分离步长、求解和表示残差
assumptions: Common compact domain, Lipschitz bounds, stable branches, bounded K inverse and residuals
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Uniform constants not established for full 3D flow/contact model; convert stage to state residual

claim_en: Chart mismatch determines a separate pullback defect
claim_zh: 图匹配误差产生独立拉回结构缺陷
assumptions: Internal ideal map exactly preserves K0 and both charts are defined and differentiable
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Add implementation/tangent defects; small geometry defect is not a trajectory bound

claim_en: 8/16-DoF and one-point Moser observations are retained
claim_zh: 8/16自由度及单点Moser结果保留
assumptions: Declared canonical point lifts; stated grids and diagnostics, not arbitrary rod mass metric
open_or_excluded_conclusion: General geometric-ROM chart integrator and uniform interval bounds are still open

claim_en: Classical discrete KAM remains open for new robot maps
claim_zh: 新机器人映射的经典离散KAM待证
assumptions: Ideal analytic exact-symplectic map; uniform analytic branch/chart; twist, frequency margins, all-integer and step nonresonance, smallness constants
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Arbitrary nonsymplectic solve/chart errors cannot be placed in a generating-perturbation budget

claim_en: Complete trainable complex network fits full-phase ROM data
claim_zh: 完整可训练复网络拟合全相空间ROM数据
assumptions: Same synthetic geometric-ROM data, specified split activation/jet/p-even construction; different capacities
open_or_excluded_conclusion: No universal complex-over-real advantage or uniform analytic error bound

claim_en: Cholesky mechanical network has positive momentum Hessian
claim_zh: Cholesky机械网络动量Hessian严格正定
assumptions: Finite real weights/input; lower-triangular L with exp diagonal; known positive nu
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Pointwise inverse does not supply usable uniform conditioning or true-mass accuracy

claim_en: SPD stress learning failed under the declared budget
claim_zh: SPD压力域在既定训练预算下失败
assumptions: Seed1025, 6001 updates, validation selection, frozen fresh confirmation; no retuning
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Cannot use near-1e12-conditioned learned mass for reliable inversion or KAM constants

claim_en: The new symmetric rod has 1:1 bending resonances
claim_zh: 新对称杆有1比1弯曲共振
assumptions: Circular isotropic material, axial bias and the declared equilibrium
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Develop resonant normal form or physically justified symmetry breaking

claim_en: A new continuous KAM certificate is not established
claim_zh: 新的连续KAM证书尚未建立
assumptions: Specific conservative analytic energy and invariant torus, theorem-specific twist/Diophantine/nondegeneracy/norm constants
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Do not transfer a frozen two-mode certificate to 12-DoF or full flow/contact system

claim_en: Legacy v10 certificate reproduction retains its original object
claim_zh: 旧v10证书复跑只保留原证明对象
assumptions: Frozen original two-mode conservative energy and exact archived assumptions/constants
open_or_excluded_conclusion: New geometric ROM, contact or dissipative robot requires new certification

claim_en: Magnetic allocation residual remains in the physical error budget
claim_zh: 磁分配残差必须进入物理误差预算
assumptions: Actual port rank and field/current/slew constraints; specified weights
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Arbitrary high-dimensional U is not exactly magnetically realizable

claim_en: Consistent potential feedback retains a Hamiltonian branch
claim_zh: 一致势形反馈保留Hamiltonian分支
assumptions: Integrable specified feedback; actual fixed-input magnetic derivative equals gradient of constructed closed-loop potential
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Saturation, sample/hold, omitted feedback derivatives and remaining nonconservative loads require separate analysis

claim_en: Fixed-current substep symplecticity does not prove sampled-feedback symplecticity
claim_zh: 固定电流子步辛性不证明采样闭环辛性
assumptions: Use the total derivative including input feedback; same continuous closed-loop reference when measuring hold error
open_or_excluded_conclusion: If the target is a sampled system itself, redefine reference and convergence object

claim_en: Internal-energy extension satisfies PSD and both degeneracy identities
claim_zh: 内能扩展满足正半定及两个退化恒等式
assumptions: Autonomous H, S prime positive, symmetric PSD C, closed mechanical-plus-reservoir system
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Open external powers remain; finite 32-state audit is not a thermal experiment

claim_en: Full thermal-fluid-magnetic deployment remains open
claim_zh: 完整热流固磁部署仍待建模
assumptions: Identify heat capacity, conduction, fluid heat transfer, electrical/hysteresis losses and thermal boundary data
open_or_excluded_conclusion: Do not invert the odd-dimensional degenerate Poisson matrix into a full Birkhoff form
